name: Behind the Bakery service counter — dead-end band between the north exterior wall (y=59.8) and the counter's back edge, traced from the PDF strokes (624.2,59.8)->(657.6,87.1)->(756.6,87.1); ~1.8 m deep, reachable only through the 1.2 m slot at the NE corner, holds no product label (staff/oven side). Wedge continues to the wall corner (767.2,59.8) and down the diagonal wall to the deli-case fixture vertex (785,83.7).
